title: Crowberry Chatcrafts
text:
Crowberry Chatcrafts

use_case_summary:
Customer-support chatbot for SMB ecommerce merchants. Retrieval-augmented answers against product/FAQ docs, automated returns/fulfillment prompts, and short summaries of customer conversations.

notes:
3/11 discovery call — CTO (Ari Navarro), Head of Product (Sofia Kim)
They run a chat-first support assistant on Shopify stores (order lookup, returns flow, canned articles).
Primary ask: cheaper model option for common queries, high-quality fallback for edge-cases.
Quoted from Ari: 'We need answers that don't hallucinate order info — embeddings + strict grounding are must-haves.'
Concerned about token costs; want to understand Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen variants for 1-2c per session target.
Interested in quick self-serve onboarding; want a POC on hosted API first, then evaluate Dedicated if growth warrants.
Legal asked about retention and audit logs; will provide SOC2 certs to legal if needed.
Would like a short benchmark run: 500 queries/day, 50 concurrent during peak, p50 latency target 200-400ms.
AE notes: prioritize short, actionable model comparison with real cost examples (token mix) and recommended fallback policies.
SE note 3/12: propose Llama-2-13B quantized / Mistral-base for mid-tier, Qwen-7B for cheap low-latency fallback.

technical_requirements:
Latency p50 target 200-400ms for single-turn quick replies
Sustained throughput ~50 req/s during peak bursts, burst capacity to 150 req/s
Session context windows up to 2k tokens, common responses 30-120 tokens
Embedding index for retrieval (approx 250k docs total), embedding cost and vector DB compatibility
Must support streaming responses for UI snappiness
Routing: prefer policy-based routing to cheaper model for high-confidence queries, fallback to higher-quality model on low-confidence or hallucination risk

model_preferences:
Wants side-by-side comparison: Llama-2 variants (13B), Mistral-small / base, Qwen-7B / 14B
Interested in quantized footprints for cheaper per-token cost
Willing to accept small quality delta for common queries if hallucination mitigation via RAG + strict grounding is enforced
Open to Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching and cache TTLs

pricing_concerns:
They asked for examples 'If we get 10k messages/month with 100 tokens in and 80 tokens out on avg, what's cost on Llama-13B quantized vs Mistral-base vs Qwen-7B + embedding costs?'. AE to send two scenarios: conservative and aggressive.

blockers:
uncertainty on per-token cost tradeoffs
legal asking about data residency in future
need benchmark on 256-token latency

next_step:
Send recommended model comparison + sample pricing calc; schedule 30m tech Q&A week of 3/22

timeline:
